Spatial Design Concept

Tropical Deccan Modernism

Designed for Bengaluru's year-round indoor-outdoor climate, AMAANG blends warm Western Ghats teakwood, porous laterite stone colonnades, hand-beaten Kumbakonam brass, and a central passive-cooling lotus courtyard.

Zone 01 • The Banyan Reflection Courtyard

450 sq.m ground level centered around a sunken reflection pool and sculptural brass banyan tree. Tables T1–T4 enjoy 4.8m ceiling clearance under retractable teak louvers.

Zone 02 • Hammered Copper Tandoor & Bar

North elevation theatrical kitchen featuring a custom wood-fired dome tandoor and backlit botanical spirit library (Counter seats C1–C2).

Zone 03 • Indiranagar & Cubbon Sky Terrace

Elevated +1.4m mezzanine lounge on the East wing accessed via floating timber stairs, featuring private pergola booths (V1–V2) overlooking the Bengaluru canopy.
